text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Starting this year, it's time to take on 
the Senior Class. When I went for New 
Year's shrine visit with Special Week...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah! S-Sorry! I was just lost in thought 
for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...This place is decorated with everyone's 
thoughts, like all sorts of goals and 
wishes, right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Like 'I'll definitely take 1st place!' or 
'I'm gonna win the Derby!'..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Like, 'I don't wanna lose to my rival,' 
or something.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Having someone you refuse to lose to makes 
your heart, and the depths of your eyes, 
burn with such passion, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I want to win. Both the race and 
against my rivals.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...I want to win at my absolute best.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehehe, I know! Since we're here, why 
don't we write down how we feel right now 
too?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply, let's set an immediate 
goal! Please make a decision here!
choice_data_list: I'm gonna learn all sorts of techniques!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ooh, I see! In that case... alright!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Let's conquer every single food stall from 
one end to the other today!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mom used to say so too! 'If you wanna 
build power, food comes first!'

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
First is amazake, of course! Then yakisoba 
and manju! And then takoyaki and~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And alongside a fully fired-up Special 
Week, we ended up completely filling our 
bellies too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... Raising the baseline of 
fundamental stats, right!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Understood! All right, first I'll do my 
best on ten stair dashes!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoa, whoops. Careful, careful. It's 
crowded right now, so it could be 
dangerous."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Then starting this evening! I look 
forward to your guidance!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And right from New Year's Day, I began 
training with a highly motivated Special 
Week.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Technique, technique, is it...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I have one, I have one!! My own 
special technique! Trainer, please watch!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Special Rolling Week Attack!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...How is it, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um, I tried combining a pro-wrestling move 
El-chan taught me with my own name, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I left the shrine while explaining that 
wasn't the case at all.
